sentences.text:
----Petitioner  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Raju Ram S/o Sona Ram, B/c Soni, R/o Padasala, P.s.
 Matoda Dist. Jodhpur.

----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr.Ramavtar Singh,
 Mr.J.K.Suthar.

For Respondent(s) : Mr.Shiv Kumar Bhati, P.P.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 19/05/2023

This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with FIR No.127/2022 registered at Police Station Matoda, District Jodhpur Rural, for offences under Sections 363, 452, 376, 380 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.

entities.text: Police Station Matoda, District Jodhpur Rural
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel submitted that as per the FIR lodged by the complainant, in the intervening night of 03-04.10.2022 in the midnight at around 1 a.m., the prosecutrix was forcibly taken away by the present petitioner from her house after being sedated by him.
In the morning of 04.10.2022, the prosecutrix was found fifty metres away from her house in an unconscious condition.
The [2023/RJJD/016201] (2 of 4) [CRLMB-3923/2023] prosecutrix on becoming conscious informed that she was subjected to sexual assault- rape by the present petitioner.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case.

Learned counsel submitted that it is highly improbable that the prosecutrix was forcibly taken away in the midnight from her house and the family members sleeping in the house would not have come to know about the prosecutrix being taken away.

Learned counsel submitted Kadar Khan vs State Of Rajasthan on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36815005/

sentences.text: that as a matter of fact, the petitioner and prosecutrix are class fellows, studying in Government Upper Primary School, Padasla in class XII.
Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner and prosecutrix are close friends.
It was submitted that the prosecutrix in the intervening night of 03-04.10.2022 voluntarily left the house to meet present petitioner.

To substantiate aforesaid contention, learned counsel drew attention of the court towards phone details filed by the investigating agency with the charge sheet dated 10.12.2022 before the competent criminal court and submitted that large number of SMSs were exchanged between the petitioner and prosecutrix during 12:44 a.m. to 3:40 a.m.
Learned counsel further submitted that the allegation of prosecutrix being subjected to sexual assault-rape is absolutely incorrect.

The attention of the Court was drawn towards the medical examination report of the prosecutrix dated 05.10.2022 prepared by the Gynecology Department, Doctor S.N. Medical College at MG Hospital, Department of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, Jodhpur wherein no external or internal injuries were found on the body of [2023/RJJD/016201] (3 of 4)
[CRLMB-3923/2023] the prosecutrix even the hymen was found intact.

entities.text: Department of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, Jodhpur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel submitted that the medical report does not support the version of the prosecution.
Lastly, learned counsel submitted that the prosecutrix has falsely implicated the petitioner in the present case under the pressure of her family members.

Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner is only 20 years old; challan has already been filed in the present case; trial of the case is likely to take long time to conclude and therefore, the petitioner deserves to be enlarged on bail.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.

Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the bail application filed by the petitioner deserves to be accepted.
It is however, made clear that findings recorded/observations made above are for limited purposes of adjudication of bail application.
The trial court shall not get prejudiced by the same.

Accordingly, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner- Kadar Khan S/o Bashir Khan shall be enlarged on bail in connection with FIR No.127/2022 registered at Police Station Matoda, District Jodhpur Rural, provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before [2023/RJJD/016201] (4 of 4)
[CRLMB-3923/2023] the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to so.
